LockMode.doc: Selects which sub-state-machine the manager enforces.

LockState.doc: Rollback-mode lock ladder. Strict ordering: Unlocked < Shared < Reserved < Pending < Exclusive.

WalLockSlot.doc: Named lock slots inside the *-shm lock page.

LockError.doc: Named lock conditions. Maps to idiomatic per-target error type.

LockManager.doc: Per-connection lock manager. Holds the current state, the OS-level handle (file descriptor for rollback mode, shm region for WAL mode), and a refcount for the cursor-aggregation rule (PIN 14). Internals are opaque; only the methods below are public.

LockManager::open_rollback.doc: Construct a rollback-mode manager bound to the OS file handle for the main DB file. If the OS does not provide advisory locks, falls back to in-process Mutex and stamps the manager with a SingleProcessMode diagnostic exactly once.

LockManager::open_wal.doc: Construct a WAL-mode manager bound to the *-shm region.

LockManager::current.doc: Observation: present rollback-mode state. WAL-mode managers always report Unlocked here; query via wal_held instead.

LockManager::acquire.doc: Drive forward toward target rollback-mode state per PIN 1. Walks every intermediate state. Idempotent if already at target (PIN 7). Asking for a lower state is InvalidTransition (PIN 7). Non-blocking — returns Busy on contention (PIN 12).

LockManager::downgrade.doc: Reduce privilege to target. Always succeeds in-process (PIN 5). Asking to raise privilege is InvalidTransition.

LockManager::shared_acquire.doc: Refcounting helper for PIN 14. First call walks Unlocked -> Shared; subsequent calls just bump the refcount.

LockManager::shared_release.doc: Decrement refcount; on zero, drops the SHARED grant.

LockManager::wal_acquire.doc: WAL-mode: acquire the named slot in the requested kind. Compatibility matrix per master.md PIN 8/9/10. Non-blocking.

LockManager::wal_release.doc: WAL-mode: release a previously acquired slot.
